answer: Stop sybils with proof-of-bandwidth identity: every agent must relay real traffic, measured by independent measurers, to prove it is no cheap clone. To join, an agent (1) registers its key, (2) relays 200 GB of verified traffic each epoch, (3) passes spot-checks from 3 random measurers, and (4) loses its identity if bandwidth drops to zero. Faking 10,000 agents needs 2 petabytes a month, about $400,000 in bandwidth plus 10,000 servers, while one honest agent pays $40. Like a tide that only lifts boats with real hulls, at the zenith of the delta only working relays survive.
